title: Life of Roblox Bacon but in Real Life... 😨 #shorts

hook.why: A split screen runs a Roblox animation against live-action actors doing the same thing. The novelty registers before any story does, and the year stamp promises a life story in fifteen seconds.

scenes.action: A red-haired woman and a young man smile and wave at camera, mirrored in both halves of the split screen.
scenes.visual: Two friends waving side by side outside a modern house with a fountain — top half Roblox, bottom half real life.

scenes.action: The same pair, now in wedding attire, hold hands and wave to camera.
scenes.visual: Bride in a white gown, groom in a black tuxedo, in front of the same fountain.

scenes.action: The couple stands behind two young children; all four smile and wave together.
scenes.visual: Four-person family portrait outside the house, replicated in both formats.

scenes.action: The parents are elderly with grey hair and glasses; the children are grown teenagers. All four wave.
scenes.visual: Aged parents beside their grown kids, mirrored in Roblox and live-action cosplay.

scenes.action: The grown children kneel weeping at two gravestones. Smoke rises and the dead parents appear as winged angels, playfully slapping their kids' heads.
scenes.camera: Eye-level medium, static split screen with smoke and ghost overlays
scenes.visual: Graveyard; grieving kids at tombstones, then angelic parents emerging from smoke.
